8:54pm: A 238-run win for Pakistan to start the tournament. Fireworks go off over the 
ground. Crowd are happy. A clinical performance with the ball from the hosts. Shaheen 
and Naseem sliced through the top order early. The conditions were tough on the body 
for the bowlers. But they persevered. Haris was destructive with his pace. Shadab 
ended up with a four-for. Fakhar's catch to dismiss Gulsan was a highlight. In the end, 
the hosts picked up two points and will take a healthy net run rate. 
Rohit Paudel, Nepal Captain: We started well. We restricted them to under 240 with the 
ball but let ourselves down with the bat. Wicket-taking balls weren't there in the middle 
overs, credit goes to Babar and their team as well. Learning from the game is we need 
to improve in the death overs, and we need to do well with the ball. 
Arish: "5 wickets from the pacers, 5 wickets from the spinners" 
Mustafa Moudi : "Even before the India-Pakistan encounter, Babar's side have already 
defeated Rohit's Team tonight!!" 
Babar Azam, Pakistan captain and POTM: (On the phases of his innings) When I went 
in, I played myself in for a couple of balls. Ball wasn't coming on, pitch was two-paced. 
Rizwan and I built a partnership and see what happened. Then, there were different 
phases. Sometimes, Rizwan gave me confidence and vice-versa. When Iftikhar came, 
we played different cricket. He can struggle a bit before he gets set. I asked him to play 
his natural game. After two-three fours, he was comfortable. He smacked it after 40 
overs. (On bowling performance) I'm satisfied. A couple of overs we were not up to the 
mark. Pacers started well, spinners struck too. This game was good preparation for the 
India game because it gave us confidence. We want to give 100% every match, hope to 
do that there as well. 
No surprises today despite Nepal's promising start with the ball. Babar and Iftikhar took 
the game firmly in the hosts' grasp. Pakistan's bowling was clinical and it gives them a 
solid net run rate. Join us tomorrow for Sri Lanka vs Bangladesh in Pallekelle. Goodbye 
for now from me, Ekanth, my report-writing co-commentator, Hemant Brar, and our 
scorers, Thilak Rama and K Vairavan.
